when_to_use: Product UI / dashboard chrome / settings / app shell / SaaS screen that must look intentional — not a festive poster; use when visual direction and anti-generic UI matter
prompt_negative: Do not ship purple-on-white / Inter-default / cream-terracotta clichés unless the brief asks; do not invent brand logos; do not decorate product UI with festive poster chrome.
